name: Connected Manufacturing
label: Industrial plant · 2 levels
summary: Plant, equipment, production cells, site utilities, loading and safety zones.

cases.title: Throughput & production flow
cases.hypothesis: Bring equipment state, congestion and materials flow together to pinpoint production bottlenecks.
cases.baseline: OEE, scrap, output and losses by shift
cases.value: More saleable output without adding capacity
cases.partner: OT data integration, line advisory and managed analytics
cases.cisco: Industrial Ethernet, OT segmentation, edge connectivity
cases.next: Pick one constrained line and validate bottleneck timestamps.

cases.title: Energy intensity & peak demand
cases.hypothesis: Identify idle loads and peak tariff exposure while preserving process quality.
cases.baseline: kWh per unit weather and production adjusted
cases.partner: Energy managed optimisation with controls OEM
cases.next: Reconcile plant loads to shift and utility meters.

cases.title: Reliability and maintenance
cases.hypothesis: Combine condition alarms, asset criticality, maintenance history and spare part lead-times.
cases.value: Reduced production loss and lower maintenance cost
cases.cisco: Industrial network and cyber resilience + analytics ISV
cases.next: Rank the top ten losses and validate failure signatures.

cases.title: Worker & vehicle safety
cases.hypothesis: Identify site safety exposure without replacing certified safety controls.
cases.baseline: Near misses, exposures and response latency
cases.value: Safety assurance and reduced disruption risk
cases.partner: Safety design / change management / managed monitoring
cases.cisco: OT segmentation + secure transport with safety specialist
cases.next: Confirm worker consultation, purpose limitation and safety authority.

cases.title: Industrial cyber exposure
cases.hypothesis: Reduce unmanaged dependencies and connectivity risks in production networks.
cases.baseline: OT asset coverage and high-risk flows
cases.value: Business continuity and lower disruption exposure
cases.partner: Managed OT security and cyber assessment
cases.cisco: Industrial security, network assurance and visibility
cases.next: Build a production-safe passive discovery plan.

story: Industrial use cases extend from the intelligent facility into throughput, maintenance and supply-chain outcomes.
